title: Behaviour vocabulary
description: The closed vocabulary of triggers, conditions and actions a behaviour may use. The term set is learned from the extraction rather than known in advance, which makes this the one runtime schema expected to gain a version in Phase 0: created here with the terms known at this point, then superseded by 1.1.0 carrying the terms the extraction derived. The shape is frozen; only the term lists change, and they change by publishing a new version file, never by editing this one.

axes.description: The mode and profile axes a behaviour may be gated on.

terms.description: Closed list, unique by construction rather than by a uniqueness keyword: JSON Schema cannot express it portably, so it is enforced by the vocabulary check instead.
